description: Reproducible model for comparing risk-averse hydropower medium-term scheduling in centralized and liberalized power systems is a model or code deposit deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Viviane Aubin. This dataset supports reproduction of the analysis of risk aversion in hydropower medium-term scheduling in centralized and liberalized power systems presented in the associated paper "Whose heads are we keeping above water? Impacts of risk aversion on hydropower medium-term scheduling" (see Related links). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
